candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Epistle of Enoch (1 Enoch 91-108) (c. 100 BC)

'Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the Most High, and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence. If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?' — cosmological theodicy: God's cosmic order is contingent on human moral order. Tewahedo agriculture-and-fasting theology (the seasonal fasts as covenant-rains-restoration) draws on this verse for its scriptural anchor.
